# Quilzo

> Quilzo gives every AI agent an identity, a policy, a budget and a signed record, asks a person before the actions that matter, and runs as one self-hosted binary.

Quilzo is one Go binary with no third-party dependencies, licensed under Apache-2.0. Source: https://github.com/Quilzo/Quilzo

## Get started

- [Get started with Quilzo in ten minutes](https://quilzo.github.io/start/): Build Quilzo, sign in, load a demo site and run your first AI agent, with or without a model. One binary, no dependencies, about ten minutes.
- [Today, the first screen after signing in](https://quilzo.github.io/today/): The first screen after signing in: what waits for you, a brief whose every figure is a link, counts, and questions answered as views you keep.
- [Install and run Quilzo in production](https://quilzo.github.io/install/): Build Quilzo from source or as a container, and run it safely: admin on loopback, TLS, a separate log writer, encrypted storage.
- [Glossary: AI agents, MCP, A2A and the words Quilzo uses](https://quilzo.github.io/concepts/): What an AI agent control plane, an MCP gateway, A2A, prompt injection, human in the loop, earned autonomy and the other terms in this manual mean, in one place.

## AI agents

- [Build an AI agent that asks before it acts](https://quilzo.github.io/agents/): Declare an AI agent's capabilities, budget and autonomy, make it ask a person before it writes anything, and read every run step by step, in the admin or as JSON.
- [Limits that hold: what a hijacked AI agent still cannot do](https://quilzo.github.io/agent-limits/): Scope what an AI agent reads and calls, cap what it spends in money, and stop a hijacked agent leaking data, with limits enforced outside the model.
- [Agents that pay, within limits a person sets](https://quilzo.github.io/payments/): Let an agent pay suppliers, top up credit or buy within a mandate a person grants: payees, a limit per payment, a budget and an end date, with a receipt each time.
- [AI agent identity: sponsors, principals and signed receipts](https://quilzo.github.io/agent-identity/): Give every AI agent its own identity and a person who answers for it, stop it when they leave, and prove what any run did with a signed, checkable receipt.
- [Evaluate AI agents against prompt injection, and let them earn autonomy](https://quilzo.github.io/evals/): Test an AI agent on real tasks, many times, with instructions planted in what it reads. It earns the right to draft or publish only by resisting them.
- [Run an AI agent's own code in a sandbox](https://quilzo.github.io/programs/): Run a coding agent, script or agent runtime in a kernel sandbox where every action goes through its declaration and models are reached through Quilzo.
- [Give an AI agent a browser it cannot misuse](https://quilzo.github.io/browser/): Let an AI agent read and act on websites in a sandboxed Chromium, with every request held to its declared hosts and every press that pays or sends approved.
- [Let an AI agent run commands without a shell to misuse](https://quilzo.github.io/workspace/): Give an AI agent a folder of its own and the programs it may run, each command in a fresh sandbox, with deletes and network use approved by a person.
- [AI agent memory people can see, correct and erase](https://quilzo.github.io/memory/): Let AI agents remember between runs without a hidden profile: memory per person, held when it came from untrusted text, and erasable with a receipt.

## Models and chatbots

- [LLM gateway: model routes, budgets in money and a privacy guard, for any AI agent](https://quilzo.github.io/models/): One gateway for every AI agent's model calls, built here or in any framework: fallback routes, budgets in money, PII masking and memory.
- [A RAG chatbot that answers from your pages and cites its sources](https://quilzo.github.io/chatbots/): Add a chatbot that answers visitors from your published pages, cites a source for every sentence, hands off to a person, and stores nothing a visitor asks.
- [Stop prompt injection in RAG: screening, guardrails and poisoned pages](https://quilzo.github.io/chatbot-safety/): Keep planted instructions out of what a RAG chatbot reads, add Lakera Guard or Google Model Armor as a second check, and catch a poisoned page early.
- [The writing assistant, and typed AI decisions with a confidence gate](https://quilzo.github.io/assistant/): Ask a model to draft pages that every publishing check still applies to, and let it answer typed questions with a confidence threshold below which a person decides.

## Connect

- [Connect AI apps and agents to Quilzo over MCP, with OAuth and receipts](https://quilzo.github.io/agent-interface/): Connect Claude, ChatGPT, coding agents or your own agents to Quilzo over MCP, locally or with OAuth 2.1, each acting as one person, with a receipt for every call.
- [MCP gateway: govern the tools AI agents call, with pinning and approvals](https://quilzo.github.io/integrations/): Give AI agents tools on MCP servers you approve, refuse a tool whose definition changed, and offer your MCP servers to other agents with approvals.
- [Govern agents built with ADK, Agent Framework, LangChain, CrewAI and the OpenAI Agents SDK](https://quilzo.github.io/frameworks/): AI agents built with ADK, Agent Framework, LangChain, CrewAI or OpenAI's Agents SDK get their tools and models through Quilzo, governed and with memory.
- [A2A: agent cards and tasks from other vendors' agents](https://quilzo.github.io/a2a/): Publish an A2A agent card that states each agent's capabilities, budget and oversight, and accept A2A 1.0 tasks from other agents, run under your declarations.
- [AI agent inventory and shadow AI detection](https://quilzo.github.io/fleet/): One inventory of every AI agent, app, tool server and model route, who answers for each, who called what from the signed log, and shadow AI.
- [The content API and the command line](https://quilzo.github.io/api/): A read-only or writable JSON content API with If-Match, and a command line where every command speaks JSON and exit codes tell a refusal from a failure.

## Content

- [Build a whole site from a sentence](https://quilzo.github.io/site/): A working site from one sentence: pages, menus, a contact form, a question box, a privacy page and a look, with every fact only you know left to fill in.
- [Bring your site from anywhere, by its address or its export](https://quilzo.github.io/bring/): Move a site in by its address or the file it exported: its pages, posts, menus, pictures and look, with redirects so its old addresses keep working.
- [Make features as packages](https://quilzo.github.io/make/): Declare a feature as one package of types, records, pages, forms, agents, webhooks and roles, read what it can do, and install it or take it back as one decision.
- [Research projects with claims you can check: numbers linked to code, real citations](https://quilzo.github.io/research/): Research projects for people and AI agents: a plan registered before the data, numbers only from code, and citations that must exist and support their claim.
- [Evolve: search over programs with a sealed evaluator](https://quilzo.github.io/evolve/): Let a model improve a program generation by generation, scored by an evaluator in its own box that the programs cannot read, with a test set and a journal.
- [Pages, sections and the editor](https://quilzo.github.io/pages/): Write pages in the admin or as JSON, build them from sections, leave notes, and see what differs from what is live, with every version kept by its hash.
- [Content types and records](https://quilzo.github.io/types/): Define content types every surface enforces, bind pages to them, and keep structured records in collections, from the admin, the command line, the API or an agent.
- [Structure, listings, menus and vocabularies](https://quilzo.github.io/structure/): Declare listings that show records on pages, menus that refuse a broken target, and controlled vocabularies, all checked before they publish.
- [Forms with retention and erasure](https://quilzo.github.io/forms/): Collect form submissions the public server cannot read back, keep them only as long as their stated purpose needs, and erase what a person asks you to.
- [A blog where every post keeps its address](https://quilzo.github.io/blog/): Posts newest first on your site: a page for each, older ones a page at a time, a feed readers follow, and the date and author search engines read.
- [Events that leave the page when they are over](https://quilzo.github.io/events/): List what is on: a page for each event, a calendar visitors subscribe to, Event data for search engines, and events gone by themselves once over.
- [Take bookings on your site, with who booked kept off it](https://quilzo.github.io/bookings/): Appointments on your site: hours in your time zone, services, free times on any page, calendar files, and names that never reach the public site.
- [A newsletter whose every reader asked for it](https://quilzo.github.io/newsletter/): A mailing list on your site: sign-ups confirmed by mail, issues sent from published pages, one-click unsubscribe, and lists moved in and out as CSV.
- [Media: images, video and provenance](https://quilzo.github.io/media/): Upload images and video with required descriptions, derive crops and renditions without losing the original, require captions, and verify C2PA provenance.
- [Design, themes and templates](https://quilzo.github.io/design/): Start from a template, generate a palette from one colour with contrast checked, and move design tokens in and out, in templates that cannot run code.
- [Languages and translations](https://quilzo.github.io/languages/): Run a site in more than one language, see which translations are missing or were made from content that has since changed, and record what each was translated from.
- [Member accounts and boards](https://quilzo.github.io/members/): Let visitors have accounts that sign in with passkeys, invite them, write on moderated boards, and erase an account completely on request.

## Release

- [Review, publish, schedule and roll back](https://quilzo.github.io/publishing/): Review what changed, let the accessibility and content gates run, publish by moving a pointer, promote through environments, and roll back at once.
- [Analytics, A/B tests and personalisation](https://quilzo.github.io/growth/): Count views, visitors, referrers and conversions without a cookie, run A/B tests that give a verdict only when there is one, and personalise by what a request says.
- [Sell through the provider's own checkout](https://quilzo.github.io/selling/): Sell the catalogue through Stripe's hosted checkout: a Buy button only where the link charges what the page says, and no card or order kept.
- [Selling to shopping agents](https://quilzo.github.io/shopping-agents/): Let shopping agents find what a shop sells, through a product feed and UCP catalog search, lookup and product, priced from published records.
- [Agents visiting your site: asking it and using its forms](https://quilzo.github.io/visiting-agents/): How visitors' AI agents use your site: ask it in plain words over NLWeb and MCP, and fill in its search, questions, forms and bookings with WebMCP.
- [Import, export, replicas and the permanent web](https://quilzo.github.io/transfer/): Leave whenever you like: export to Markdown, WordPress WXR, lossless JSON or RO-Crate, bring a live site or its export in, replicate, and publish to IPFS.

## Protection

- [The shield: Quilzo defends itself](https://quilzo.github.io/shield/): Playbooks decided in advance block, slow, lock down or pause the moment an attack shows; every protection ends by itself; changes take two admins.
- [Sign-ins: risky ones confirmed, lockouts and where they come from](https://quilzo.github.io/signins/): Every sign-in, where it came from and how risky it looked; a risky one waits until its person proves it, and failed ones lock out only the places they come from.

## Compliance and audit

- [Security posture and compliance frameworks](https://quilzo.github.io/security/): Continuous checks of how Quilzo is configured, each with why it matters and the fix, read as FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR and the EU AI Act.
- [EU AI Act and ISO/IEC 42001 evidence, and an AI bill of materials](https://quilzo.github.io/ai-evidence/): Evidence for the EU AI Act's deployer duties and ISO/IEC 42001 Annex A, read from what your agents, chatbots and models did, and a CycloneDX AI bill of materials.
- [Evidence for an assessment: NIST 800-53, OSCAL and FedRAMP 20x](https://quilzo.github.io/compliance/): Show how Quilzo implements each NIST 800-53 control in OSCAL, draft an SSP, report FedRAMP 20x indicators, and give auditors one verifiable file.
- [Content provenance and AI disclosure](https://quilzo.github.io/provenance/): Record who or what wrote every page, mark AI-generated content as the EU AI Act asks, and refuse to publish a page whose origin is unrecorded.
- [Tamper-evident audit log with signed heads and proofs](https://quilzo.github.io/logging/): Every action in a hash-chained log, identifiers pseudonymised, heads signed with Ed25519 and ML-DSA, with proofs, anchoring and RFC 3161 timestamps.
- [Privacy: what Quilzo keeps about people](https://quilzo.github.io/privacy/): What Quilzo keeps about visitors, members, staff and customers, how long, and how each is erased: forms, chatbot questions, analytics, memory, prompts and notices.

## Administration

- [People, roles and permissions for working with agents](https://quilzo.github.io/people/): Grant roles on any part of the site, give jobs and agent permissions such as approve on one agent, deny where it must win, and explain why anybody can act.
- [Single sign-on with OIDC and SAML](https://quilzo.github.io/sso/): Sign in to the Quilzo admin with Google Workspace, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, or any OIDC or SAML provider, required per domain, with break-glass accounts.
- [SCIM provisioning from Okta and Entra](https://quilzo.github.io/provisioning/): Let Okta, Microsoft Entra or another identity provider create, update, suspend and delete people through SCIM, with their groups mapped to Quilzo roles and jobs.
- [Passkeys, tokens and sessions](https://quilzo.github.io/passkeys/): Sign in with passkeys and no password, issue API tokens scoped below their holder, exchange a token for a short session, and set session limits.
- [Credentials for programs and CI jobs](https://quilzo.github.io/credentials/): Let CI jobs exchange their platform's identity token for a short Quilzo token, narrow any token with RFC 8693, and bind tokens to a key with DPoP.
- [Settings and outbound network control](https://quilzo.github.io/settings/): Every setting with what it is for and what it costs, a recorded reason for any weakening, and every outbound connection named, with an offline mode.
- [Run Quilzo on an isolated or air-gapped network](https://quilzo.github.io/isolated/): Run Quilzo on an isolated network with no outbound connections, a local model, classification markings, encrypted storage and recorded transfers across the gap.

## More

- [Rooms and calls (experimental)](https://quilzo.github.io/collaboration/): Experimental building blocks: rooms with a stated purpose, calls encrypted end to end with SFrame (RFC 9605), screen sharing and an AI note-taker.
- [Licence: Apache-2.0](https://quilzo.github.io/licence/): Quilzo is open source under the Apache License 2.0. Use it, change it, embed it in your own product and sell it, with no licence key and nothing held back.
